subject: general
question: When 4230, 5986 and 9059 are divided by the greatest number m, the remainder in each case is n. What is the value of (m - n)?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Numbers are 4230, 5986 and 9059

**CONCEPT USED:**

Dividend = Quotient x Divisor + Remainder 

**CALCULATION:**

Let the numbers are:

4230 = X × m + n...........(1)

5986 = Y ×** **m + n............(2)

9059 = Z × m + n..............(3)

Where X.Y and Z are quotient , m is divisor and n is remainder ,

Now on subtracting equation (3) - (2), (2) - (1), and (3) - (1) we get,

9059 - 5986 = ( Z-Y) × m

⇒ 3073 = ( Z-Y) × m

5986 - 4230 =( Y-X) × m

⇒ 1756 = ( Y-X) × m

9059 - 4230 =( Z-X) × m

⇒ 4829 =( Z-X) × m

Hence H.C.F of (3073,1756, 4829) is m 

⇒ m = 439 

Then from equation (1) , (2) and (3) we get ,

⇒ 4230 = 9×439 +279

⇒5986 =13 ×439 +279

⇒9059 =20 ×439 + 279 

Hence , m = 439 and n =279 

Now, (m-n) = 160.

**⇒ Now , the value of (m-n) =160.**
